documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 48.8% year-on-year for the quarter and EBITDA/PAT margins more than doubling. The growth was driven by a mix of price increases, volume gains, and contributions from recent initiatives like the VDA acquisition and Restar Corporation joint venture. Management noted that inventory was built up to support the festive season and secure supply in a constrained market, and they intend to convert this inventory to cash in the second half. Looking ahead, the company remains cautious on consumer demand while remaining confident in enterprise, semiconductor, and managed services growth opportunities. Rashi Peripherals Limited published its investor presentation for Q2/H1-FY27, reporting strong operational and financial performance including record-high profits and revenue growth across standalone and consolidated segments.

guidance.claim: Management expects commercial and enterprise demand to be a steadier part of the market in the second half.
guidance.quote: We expect commercial and enterprise demand to be steadier part of the market in the second half, and we are managing inventory and credit accordingly.

guidance.claim: Management estimates an EBITDA margin of around 2.75% for long-term horizons.
guidance.quote: I would like to say that around 2.75% EBITDA margin is a safe bet to consider for such long-term horizons.

guidance.claim: Management expects new businesses like VDA and Restar JV to contribute more than 10% of top line going forward.
guidance.quote: We plan that they should contribute to more than 10% of our top line.

guidance.claim: Management expects an average price increase of 10% to 15% in the second half.
guidance.quote: So, on an average, in H2, we still expect 10% to 15% price increase.

demand_outlook.claim: IDC reported that India's PC market grew by about 12% in the April to June quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: IDC reported that India's PC market grew by about 12% in the April to June quarter, led by commercial, education and small business demand and also by premium and AI-capable notebooks.

demand_outlook.claim: Part of the strength reflects channel partner buying ahead of future price increases, and higher prices are affecting consumer affordability.
demand_outlook.quote: We should be clear eyed though part of the strength reflects channel partner buying ahead of future price increase and higher prices are now affecting consumer affordability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the impact of softening consumer demand has been miniscule because the commercial market continues to grow very strong.
demand_outlook.quote: While because of the continued price rise, there is a possible contraction in the consumer market. But the commercial market continues to grow very strong, which is almost 70% of India's total ICT market. So, in short, the impact so far is miniscule.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that AI usage or implementation in India is at a very nascent stage.
demand_outlook.quote: So, AI usage or implementation in India is at a very, very nascent stage.

demand_outlook.claim: Management forecasts a conservative second half for consumer business with a degrowth in terms of unit-wise, while commercial business could be flat or positive.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the conservative forecast for H2 will be that consumer business, there will be a degrowth in terms of unit-wise. Commercial business could be flat or positive.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, system integration, and managed IT services through the announced acquisition of a 67% stake in VDA Infosolutions.
capex_expansion.quote: Expanded into enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, system integration, and managed IT services through the announced acquisition of a 67% stake in VDA Infosolutions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company formalised a joint venture with Japan-based Restar Corporation to establish an Embedded & Semiconductor solutions business.
capex_expansion.quote: Formalised a joint venture with Japan-based Restar Corporation to establish an Embedded & Semiconductor solutions business, supported by local design and engineering, talent transfer, and technical services.

capex_expansion.claim: Branch operations were expanded to deepen pan-India reach and last-mile access across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities and emerging commercial hubs.
capex_expansion.quote: Expanded branch operations to deepen pan-India reach and last-mile access across Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities and emerging commercial hubs.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved by close to 100 basis points in the quarter due to mix and pricing discipline.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margins improved by close to 100 basis points in the quarter. So, the expansion is coming from mix and pricing discipline, not only operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, EBITDA margins expanded 106 basis points to 3.56% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue from operations for the quarter grew by 49% year-on-year to INR6,185 crores. EBITDA increased significantly by 112% year-on-year to INR220 crores, with margins expanding 106 basis points to 3.56%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that 30% of their 50% growth came from price increases, 10% to 11% from volume increases, and 10% from new businesses.
margins_costs.quote: Karan, so if you ask me very discretely, our 50% growth can be very simply dissected in 30% growth has come from the price increase, which is the trend. 10% to 11% has come from the volume increase, which is the unit increase and 10% has come from new businesses.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates across 57 branches, 50 service centers, and 728 locations.
orders_capacity.quote: Our branch head structure keeps decision close to the customer and our 57 branches, 50 service centers and 728 locations reach deep into Tier 2 and Tier 3 India, where penetration is lowest and growth is highest.

orders_capacity.claim: The company engages with an ecosystem of 10,280 channel partners across 728 towns of India.
orders_capacity.quote: Our focus remains on solution selling, deeper customer engagement and very importantly, increasing the wallet share across our 10,280 channel partner ecosystem, which is spread across 728 towns of India.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the QIP preparation is an advanced preparation for growth capital.
capital_allocation.quote: With regards to the QIP, yes, you're absolutely right that this QIP preparation is a little -- we are doing as an advanced preparation for growth engine.

management_commitments.claim: Converting inventory into cash in the second half is a stated priority.
management_commitments.quote: Converting the cash inventory into cash in the second half is a priority, and we will report on our progress next quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Second half priorities include converting inventory to cash, bringing working capital back towards historical levels, integrating VDA carefully, and building the leadership and engineering team for the semiconductor joint venture.
management_commitments.quote: Lastly, our priorities for second half are clear: convert inventory to cash and bring working capital back towards our historical levels, integrate VDA carefully and retain its people and client, build the leadership and engineering team for semiconductor joint venture.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
